method.ratio: WCAG 2 contrast ratio (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05) on relative luminance from 8-bit sRGB (threshold 0.04045); the reported ratio rounds to 4 decimals, and every mark and comparison uses the unrounded value.
method.marks: aa: ratio >= 4.5 (normal text); large: ratio >= 3 (large text and UI components). A ui pairing is measured against 3:1; failAA counts text pairings only.
method.worse: worse: the candidate ratio is below the Bootstrap-alone ratio of the same pairing by more than 1e-9.
method.alpha: An alpha foreground is composited over its background in gamma-encoded sRGB with 8-bit rounding, and the composite is measured against that background.
method.mix: tint-color = mix(#fff, color, w), shade-color = mix(#000, color, w); each channel = round(c1 * w + c2 * (1 - w)) with halves rounded up, as the probe verified against the lifted sheet.
method.text: Text colors stay the shipped literal (#fff or #000) under every candidate because Tailwind's white and black are the same values. contrastPick is Bootstrap's color-contrast() over the candidate background with its own luminance table and $min-contrast-ratio 4.5; flips marks a background where a Sass rerun emits the other text color.
method.bootstrap: Bootstrap alone reads each foreground and background literal from inventory.json (selector and property in the lifted sheet); the run asserts Bootstrap's algebra over the _variables.scss bases reproduces it.

candidates.base-500: Each theme color's base is Tailwind step 500 of its family; $light is gray-100 and $dark is gray-900; every gray is Tailwind gray at the same step; hover, active, text-emphasis, bg-subtle, border-subtle (light and dark), table, link, focus, and validation colors follow Bootstrap's algebra over those bases.
candidates.base-600: As base-500 with step 600 for the theme-color bases.
candidates.ramp: Tailwind ramp roles: base 600, hover 700, active 800, bg-subtle 100, border-subtle 200, text-emphasis 800, table bg 100; dark text-emphasis 300, bg-subtle 950, border-subtle 700; link 600, link hover 700, dark link 300, dark link hover 200, input focus border 300, dark valid and invalid 300; $light is gray-100 (hover 200, active 300); $dark is gray-900 (hover 800, active 700, lighter like Bootstrap's tint); Bootstrap's gray roles map step for step, with mix($gray-100, $white) to gray-50 and mix($gray-800, $black) to gray-950; table stripe, active, and hover backgrounds follow Bootstrap's factors over the ramp-100 table bg.

checks: WCAG ratio of #ffffff on #000000 is 21 and of a color on itself is 1; #0d6efd on #ffffff lies in (4.5, 4.51); a 20% tint of #0d6efd differs from the 80% tint #cfe2ff (reversed-weight control); Bootstrap color-contrast() picks #ffffff on #0d6efd and #000000 on #ffc107; #0d6efd at alpha .25 over #ffffff composites to #c3dbff

Every Bootstrap-alone pairing reads its foreground and background from the lifted sheet's literal (inventory.json selector and property, 348 lookups), and Bootstrap's algebra over the _variables.scss bases reproduces each of those literals exactly; every Bootstrap-alone role color occurs in the lifted sheet; Bootstrap's color-contrast() reproduces every shipped text color
